effect.name: GM Particle Control
effect.desc: A real particle system built in layer space. One particle per lattice cell, each with its own jittered start position, its own size, its own phase and its own colour taken from the layer underneath it, so the particles are made of the layer's own pixels. Six behaviours: dissolve outward, rise, explode, swirl, fall, and orbit. Gravity, turbulence, a spread control, size variation, an anisotropic trail stretch, a soft glow halo, colour boost, a per-particle birth and death cycle and the lattice density are all independent. The lattice centre is a layer point, so the whole system rides the layer.
